site_note: candybeautystudio.com and candybeautystudiomiami.com do not resolve (gateway 502 / not registered or inactive). No website_candidates in Booksy dossier. Confirmed has_own_site=false.
phone_note: No phone number found after WebSearch (business name + address), Booksy static HTML fetch (SPA, no telephone in markup), Yelp/Birdeye/Facebook search (no dedicated listing found for this exact LLC, only similarly-named unrelated businesses like Candy Coated Beauty, Candy Beauty Spa). phone: null.
email_note: IG web_profile_info endpoint (x-ig-app-id method) returned a blocked/malformed response on 2 retries with pauses (not a real Instagram payload). Booksy raw HTML has no mailto/business email (only booksy.com's own support address). No dedicated Facebook business page found to check About section. Sources exhausted, email: null.
brand_vibe: candy-pink: a vivid, tasteful raspberry-to-candy-pink duotone tied to the name 'Candy' and the owner Candy Hernandez, distinct from the plum-pink (#a04a72/#c47a9c) and rosa dark palettes already used elsewhere. Tokens: bg #fdf2f6, bg-2 #f9d9e6, ink #341f28, accent-deep #d1327a, accent-mid #f072ab, accent-soft #f9d9e6.
curation_note: Booksy pool has only 6 clean, usable photos out of 16 downloaded (bk-3, bk-4, bk-5, bk-6, bk-14, bk-15): the rest show emoji/text stickers over faces (bk-10, bk-13), a 2-photo collage in a single file (bk-1), portraits looking away from the work (bk-11, bk-12), multi-person team/event collages (bk-8, bk-9, bk-16), a lifestyle shot too low-res to use at any real size (bk-2, 150x150px), or a client resting with closed eyes (bk-7). Per DESIGN.md, built a 6-tile set instead of forcing 8: bk-3 as hero (pink background matches the candy-pink accent), bk-6/bk-4/bk-5 as lash macro details, bk-14/bk-15 as full-glam makeup work (cropped object-top to keep focus on the face). bk-5 and bk-15 are reused in the Experience section, matching the reuse pattern already present in the light-v2 exemplar when the photo pool is limited.
